description: A row of dancers joined hand to hand, facing alternately, rocks forward and back.

walkthrough.line: In your wave, rock toward the dancer you face as far as the hands allow, then rock back.
walkthrough.teach: You are in a wave: give your {hand} hand to the dancer one place along the set and your other hand to the one behind you, so every hand along the row is joined and the dancers beside you look the other way. Rock toward the dancer you are facing as far as the joined hands allow, and rock back the same way. Stay on your own place.
